ENV.description: Leave this as it is: it makes the bot read its settings from these config vars.

TOKEN.description: Your bot token. Get one from @BotFather.

API_ID.description: API_ID from my.telegram.org (used by the Telethon/Pyrogram modules).

OWNER_ID.description: Your Telegram user id (a number). Send /id to @MissRose_bot to find it.

SUPPORT_CHAT.description: Username of your support group, without the @. Leave empty if you have none.

EVENT_LOGS.description: Id of a channel/group where the bot logs gbans, sudo changes and errors, eg -1001234567890. The bot must be admin there.

JOIN_LOGGER.description: Id of a channel/group where the bot logs the groups it is added to.

DEV_USERS.description: Space separated user ids with full owner-like access (shell, eval...). Only add people you trust completely.

DRAGONS.description: Space separated user ids of sudo users.

DEMONS.description: Space separated user ids of support users (can gban).

TIGERS.description: Space separated user ids of tiger users (can't be banned or muted by the bot).

WOLVES.description: Space separated user ids of whitelisted users.

AI_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key for the chatbot (/chatbot on). Get one at https://console.anthropic.com

AI_MODEL.description: Claude model used by the chatbot.

OPENWEATHERMAP_ID.description: Optional OpenWeatherMap key for /weather. Without it wttr.in is used.

CASH_API_KEY.description: Optional Alpha Vantage key for /cash. Without it free daily rates are used.

GENIUS_API_TOKEN.description: Optional Genius token for better /lyrics results (https://genius.com/api-clients).

SPAMWATCH_API.description: Optional SpamWatch API token, get one from @SpamWatchBot.

HEROKU_API_KEY.description: Optional, for the /see var, /set var and /usage owner commands.

HEROKU_APP_NAME.description: Optional, the name of this Heroku app (needed with HEROKU_API_KEY).

STRICT_GBAN.description: Ban gbanned users in every group when they talk.

ALLOW_EXCL.description: Allow ! as a command prefix as well as /.

DEL_CMDS.description: Delete commands from users who don't have the rights to use them.

NO_LOAD.description: Space separated module names you don't want to load.

BL_CHATS.description: Space separated chat ids the bot should leave.

DONATION_LINK.description: Optional link where you receive donations.

BAN_STICKER.description: Optional file id of a sticker sent before banning people.
